messages.author: 090206f3e57a902f
messages.subject: Warning message in running thr DEC
parts:
Hi dear

recently i have started to work with the BioGeoBears using the http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#script

I can proceed based on this but at the end when I want to run DEC, i get this warning message:

Warning message:
In (function (npt = min(n + 2L, 2L * n), rhobeg = NA, rhoend = NA,  :
  unused control arguments ignored

would you please help me?

The best 
Niloo
